name: guardrails
description: Safety and review of Claude's output, helped by local decision models. Mods: blast-radius, secret-sentry, reflect (/reflect-queue, /reflect-pause), assumption-tracker (/assumptions), self-critique (/critique), prompt-coach (/sharpen), merge-sweep, decision-gate (/decide-bench), auto-answer, model-picker.

blastRadius.title: blast-radius
blastRadius.description: Asks before destructive shell commands run

secretSentry.title: secret-sentry
secretSentry.description: Blocks API keys and private keys from being written into files

reflect.title: reflect
reflect.description: Spots corrections in your prompts and saves them as rules in CLAUDE.md

assumptionTracker.title: assumption-tracker
assumptionTracker.description: Lists the assumptions Claude made and sends fixes for the ones you mark wrong

selfCritique.title: self-critique
selfCritique.description: /critique panel that reviews Claude's last answer, with one-click fixes

promptCoach.title: prompt-coach
promptCoach.description: Rewrites your first prompt into a better one that makes Claude ask you the open questions first

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: theme follows your Claude Code theme (light, dark, colour-blind); pastel is fixed colours tuned for dark terminals

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Animate the busy rails while a critique or prompt rewrite runs, or keep them still

mergeSweep.title: merge-sweep
mergeSweep.description: Offers to clean up branches and worktrees once a PR created in the session is merged

decisionGate.title: decision-gate
decisionGate.description: Lets a local Ollama decision model approve routine tool calls; unsure ones are put to you

autoAnswer.title: auto-answer
autoAnswer.description: Lets a local decision model answer Claude's questions when the context alone decides them

modelPicker.title: model-picker
modelPicker.description: Lets a local decision model pick the cheapest model that fits a subagent or your first prompt

decisionThreshold.title: Decision threshold
decisionThreshold.description: How sure a local decision model must be (0-1) before its answer is used

decisionTimeoutMs.title: Decision timeout (ms)
decisionTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for a warm local decision model before asking as usual

ollamaUrl.title: Ollama URL
ollamaUrl.description: Where the local decision models are served

fastModel.title: Fast decision model
fastModel.description: Pin the fast tier to this model (empty: chosen by the benchmark)

strongModel.title: Strong decision model
strongModel.description: Pin the strong tier to this model (empty: chosen by the benchmark)

benchEveryDays.title: Benchmark every (days)
benchEveryDays.description: Re-run the decision model benchmark after this many days

subagentModels.title: Subagent models
subagentModels.description: Comma-separated models model-picker chooses from, cheapest first
